onboarding.step1Body: A fast, focused way to clean up your photo library — one swipe at a time.
onboarding.step2Title: Swipe left to trash, right to keep
onboarding.step2Body: Pick a category, then swipe through candidates. Left queues a photo for deletion, right keeps it.
onboarding.step3Body: A left swipe just moves a photo to Trash — it stays there until you choose to permanently delete it.
onboarding.declineBody: Swipix needs you to accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy to work. If you'd rather not, please close the app — nothing has been set up or accessed yet.

terms.p1: Swipix helps you review and delete photos on your device. You're responsible for the choices you make while using it — including which photos you delete.
terms.p2: Deleted photos go to Trash first, not permanently — nothing is ever deleted automatically. Once you confirm permanent deletion yourself, it cannot be undone by the app. Make sure anything important is backed up elsewhere.
terms.p3: The app is provided "as is," with no warranty of any kind, including the accuracy of any automatic photo categorization (like blurry, similar, or large files). To the fullest extent permitted by law, the developer isn't liable for any loss of photos or data, or losses from mistaken deletions, from using this app.
terms.p4: These terms may change at any time, for any reason, including to reflect new features, pricing, or legal requirements. Continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated terms.
terms.p5: Swipix may add, change, or remove features at any time. This currently includes a single ad, served by Google AdMob, shown when you choose to permanently empty your trash — emptying never depends on that ad loading. Subscriptions or one-time purchases may be introduced in the future.

privacy.p1: Swipix has no backend, no accounts, and no analytics or activity tracking. The one exception is Google AdMob, used to show a single, non-personalized ad when you empty your trash — nothing else you do in the app is ever sent anywhere.
privacy.p2: Photo library access is used only on your device, in the moment you're using the app, to let you view, organize, and delete photos and videos you choose. Photos are never uploaded or shared.
privacy.p3: A few small preferences — your language, filter settings, and what's currently in the trash — are stored locally on your device and removed when you uninstall the app.
privacy.p4: Swipix shows one non-personalized ad, via Google AdMob, when you choose to permanently empty your trash — it never blocks that action if no ad is available. Swipix currently has no payments. If that changes in the future, this policy will be updated first, and you'll be asked for any consent required at that time.
privacy.p5: This policy may be updated at any time. Continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated policy.
